title: Dira — your commitments, kept
disclosure: Actual public product screenshots, held and edited for English narration. This is an edited walkthrough, not elapsed execution time. Public action tools are synthetic; live inference and dated actual-provider evidence are distinguished in each scene.

scenes.title: A changed date can break a promise
scenes.caption: A synthetic student week · private to this demo session
scenes.narration: A calendar shows dates. Dira tracks the promises connected to them. When a professor moves a midterm, preparation time, an interview buffer, and a teammate's work can all break. This public demo uses synthetic people and simulated action tools. It never contacts a real person.

scenes.title: Nemotron proposes. Code decides.
scenes.caption: Live Nebius Token Factory inference · simulated actions
scenes.narration: The email is interpreted by NVIDIA Nemotron Super on Nebius Token Factory. Ultra proposes structured repair intents. Deterministic code checks provenance, feasibility and policy. Slack falls from plus four point one hours to minus three point six. Delegation pauses for authenticated approval; the model cannot grant it.

scenes.title: Read the changed world back
scenes.caption: Independent simulated read-back · durable action ledger
scenes.narration: After approval, Dira handles a stale interview slot, replans within the granted policy, and reads each changed surface again. The repair restores slack to plus one point three hours. The flight record retains rejected proposals and recovered failures. Current reads are compared with the versioned synthetic reference week.

scenes.title: The owner sets the boundary
scenes.caption: Draft-only mail, approval rules, and source fences
scenes.narration: The owner can fence sources, require approval and keep real mail as drafts. Typed stakeholders and deterministic templates decide who can be contacted and what is sent. A hostile email cannot change those permissions. The public broker uses an audited application allowlist; OpenShell does not surround this hosted broker.

scenes.title: Actual provider checks, with limits
scenes.caption: Calendar source→approval→read-back · Gmail drafts only
scenes.narration: Separate dated tests exercised actual Google Calendar review, approval, a broker move and independent provider read-back. Actual Gmail tests created and recovered self-addressed synthetic drafts without duplication. No mail was sent; Gmail inbox interpretation was not tested. Google access remains an owner pilot, with token continuity still open.

scenes.title: Persistence you can inspect
scenes.caption: Private Git memory · confirmed rules · explicit source health
scenes.narration: Encrypted private Git memory holds account graphs, policies and reusable Skills. A restored rule required approval for a later synthetic move in the policy check. Today separates source enrollment from successful sync history. Owner Hermes enrollment remains unfinished because the local gateway failed its bridge probe. No always-on owner workflow is claimed.

scenes.title: Measured contribution, reproducible fallback
scenes.caption: Ultra: 3/11 acceptable proposals · 2/7 selected repairs
scenes.narration: The recorded seven-case live evaluation resolved every scenario. Ultra supplied the only feasible proposal in the overlap case, but won only two cases overall; three of eleven proposals passed every gate. Deterministic fallback remains essential. Explore the free credential-free replay, dated evidence and licensed source at dira nemetron. Dira keeps commitments connected.
